verdict.rationale: Netlify's evidence covers serverless functions, edge functions, databases, storage, and CI/CD deploy previews, but there is no mention of a durable/long-running workflow orchestration primitive (e.g., background jobs with built-in retries, queues, or workflow-as-code) comparable to Vercel's workflow/queue offerings. Functions are described as short-lived serverless invocations, not durable workflows.
